skill_drafts.description: Explicitly close an AgentOps session with a terminal status label, ensuring all telemetry and logs are flushed and the session record is finalized.
skill_drafts.objective: Cleanly terminate an agent session and persist its outcome
applicable_signals: No further interactions expected in this session
contraindications: Do not call during active agent execution
Do not call when the session should remain open for further interactions
Do not call in error handlers that need to preserve session state for debugging

triggers: All agent actions and responses are finalized
Ready to close the session and record final status
constraints: Must be called after all agent actions are complete

cautions: Calling end_session() is irreversible; the session cannot be reopened
